div.div: 2 وَرَّشَ بَيْنَ القَوْمِ , (S,) inf. n. تَوْريِشٌ, (S, K,) He excited discord, dissension, disorder, strife, quarrelling, or animosity, between, or among, the people; syn. حَرَّشَ; (S, K;) as also أَرَّشَ (S) [and هَرَّشَ]. See also 1, last signification.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
